Found 10 items in registries @mewo:

Showing items 1-10 of 10:

- text-shimmer (registry:ui) - A light sweep that moves across text. CSS only — no dependencies. [@mewo] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- marquee (registry:ui) - An infinite horizontal scroller with a seamless loop. CSS only — no dependencies. [@mewo] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- split-text (registry:ui) - Characters or words stagger into view when scrolled to. Powered by GSAP and ScrollTrigger. [@mewo] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- spotlight-card (registry:ui) - A card with a radial glow that follows the pointer. Powered by Motion. [@mewo] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- scroll-reveal (registry:ui) - Fades and slides its children in when they enter the viewport. Powered by Motion. [@mewo] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- aurora-background (registry:ui) - A slowly drifting gradient backdrop with a fade-in for its content. CSS keyframes plus Motion. [@mewo] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- hero-aurora (registry:block) - A hero section: aurora backdrop, word-by-word headline, description and two call-to-action buttons. [@mewo] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- features-spotlight (registry:block) - A features section: shimmering eyebrow, heading, a scroll-revealed grid of spotlight cards and a logo marquee. [@mewo] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- tabs (registry:ui) - Drop-in replacement for shadcn's tabs. Adds an indicator that slides between tabs instead of jumping. Same exports, same props. [@mewo] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- collapsible (registry:ui) - Drop-in replacement for shadcn's collapsible, which ships with no animation at all. Adds eased height and a content fade. Same exports, same props. [@mewo] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`
